findings.reasoning: Lines 20434-20438 register a document-level keydown that hides this popup on Escape; it touches nothing in state.seqs or the undo stacks. Even when it fires while a window is open or the busy overlay is up (it does not check _alignmentKeysAway, since it is registered at document level and is unaffected by handleKeyDown's 16800-16818 early return), the only effect is `popup.style.display = 'none';` at 20436 — an idempotent hide, so even if the wiring runs on every popup open and listeners accumulate, the visible result is the same.
findings.scenario: Popup open, user starts realign and the busy overlay appears; Escape hides the popup (harmless, no data touched). No path from this listener to wrong data or lost undo steps.
findings.title: Escape anywhere hide-only handler for the sequence-test popup is benign even during an aligner run
